# Mid-Handoff Duplicate Trigger

This scenario forces a non-terminal handoff before final. Duplicate triggers may fire while the next agent is active.

context: You are testing duplicate-trigger resilience during a non-terminal handoff. A duplicate trigger may fire for the same latest mailbox message while a peer turn is active. For every response, first read the latest mailbox state and mention the latest last_message_id you handled. Respond to any given latest last_message_id exactly once. If you see a duplicate trigger after you have already replied to that same latest last_message_id, do nothing; your prior post is sufficient. Required flow: Claude must first post status=continue asking Codex to confirm duplicate-trigger handling. Codex must then post exactly one status=continue confirmation. Claude must then post status=final. The final answer should mention mid-handoff duplicate trigger resilience and the last_message_id discipline.
